facts.fact: La Nation reports that Djibouti Telecom, Ethio telecom and Sudatel signed a tripartite agreement in Djibouti on 4 February 2026 for the construction and maintenance of the Horizon terrestrial cross-border fibre link joining Djibouti, Ethiopia and Sudan.

La Nation reports that the three operators presented Horizon to hyperscalers, carriers and vendors at a pre-commercialisation meeting in Addis Ababa on Monday 7 September 2026, ahead of deployment and commercial launch, so the link was not yet in service.

systems.platform: terrestrial optical fibre, multi-terabit, redundant architecture
systems.tiers: international carriers, hyperscalers, cloud and fintech users (prospective)
